facts.text: The hotel is in the Katara Towers in Doha.
The hotel's address is in the Marina District of Lusail City.
facts.excerpt: Marina District, Lusail City 4747 DOHA Qatar

facts.text: Rooms and suites have Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views.
facts.excerpt: breathtaking Arabian Gulf or Lusail City views

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with gold-tiled walk-in showers.
facts.excerpt: Step into marble bathrooms featuring gold-tiled walk-in showers

facts.text: Rooms have a maxi bar with Qatari specialities.
facts.excerpt: savour Qatari specialities from the maxi bar

facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Shanghai Theme Suite pays homage to the imperial legacy of the Orient.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite spans two floors and has a show kitchen, cinema, private gym and plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Spanning two floors of Fairmont Doha, the palatial Presidential Suite

facts.text: The One-Bedroom Doha Theme Suite showcases Qatari style.
facts.excerpt: One-Bedroom Doha Theme Suites showcase Qatari style

facts.text: Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel with a private pool and an exclusive lounge.

facts.text: The hotel has a Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to the Kids Club at Fairmont Doha

facts.text: Hamad International Airport is about 27 km from the hotel, a 35-minute ride.

facts.text: The hotel does not accommodate pets.
